/* Collapsible sidebar */
@media (min-width: 769px) {
    .sidebar {
        width: 250px;
        min-width: 250px;
        transition: width 0.24s ease, min-width 0.24s ease, box-shadow 0.24s ease;
        overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed {
        width: 74px;
        min-width: 74px;
    }

    .sidebar.sidebar-expanded {
        width: 250px;
        min-width: 250px;
        box-shadow: 6px 0 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
    }

    .sidebar-profile {
        min-height: 68px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .sidebar-profile > div,
    .sidebar-section-title,
    .sidebar-item span,
    .sidebar-group summary span,
    .sidebar-group summary .bi-chevron-down {
        transition: opacity 0.16s ease, visibility 0.16s ease;
    }

    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-profile {
        justify-content: center;
        padding-left: 0 !important;
        padding-right: 0 !important;
    }

    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-profile > div,
    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-section-title,
    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-item span,
    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-group summary span,
    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-group summary .bi-chevron-down {
        opacity: 0;
        visibility: hidden;
        width: 0;
        max-width: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-item,
    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-group summary {
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 0;
        padding-left: 0 !important;
        padding-right: 0 !important;
    }

    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-item i,
    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-group summary > i:first-child {
        font-size: 1.2rem;
        width: 44px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-group[open] > .sidebar-item,
    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-subitem {
        display: none;
    }

    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-profile-photo {
        margin: 0;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    }

    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-profile-photo:hover,
    .sidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-profile-photo:focus {
        transform: scale(1.04);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(27, 57, 106, 0.16);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
}

.sidebar {
    background-color: var(--soft-bg);
    border-right-color: var(--border-color);
}

.sidebar-profile {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 0 20px 20px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.sidebar-profile-photo,
.profile-thumb {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
}

.sidebar-profile-photo {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-color: var(--border-color);
}

.sidebar-profile strong,
.sidebar-profile small {
    display: block;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.sidebar-profile small {
    color: var(--text-muted);
}

.user-nav-link {
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
}

.sidebar-group summary {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 12px 20px;
    color: var(--text-dark);
    cursor: pointer;
    list-style: none;
}

.sidebar-group summary::-webkit-details-marker {
    display: none;
}

.sidebar-group[open] summary .bi-chevron-down {
    transform: rotate(180deg);
}

.sidebar-subitem {
    padding-left: 42px;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .content-wrapper {
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    .sidebar {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        min-height: auto;
        border-right: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        padding: 12px 0;
    }

    .sidebar-item,
    .sidebar-group summary {
        padding: 10px 16px;
    }

    .sidebar-profile {
        padding: 0 16px 12px;
    }

    .container-xl {
        padding-left: 14px;
        padding-right: 14px;
    }

    .navbar-brand img {
        height: 38px;
    }

    .navbar-brand-text span:first-child {
        font-size: 0.75rem;
    }

    .navbar-brand-text span:last-child {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .btn-group {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .management-menu {
        min-width: 100%;
    }

    .management-menu-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .repository-reader {
        min-height: 460px;
    }

    .repository-reader-frame {
        min-height: 68vh;
    }

    .repository-word-preview {
        min-height: 460px;
        padding: 22px;
    }

    .repository-epub-viewer {
        min-height: 500px;
    }

    .stat-card {
        padding: 14px;
    }

    .stat-card .card-body {
        padding: 12px;
    }
}

/* Mobile hardening overrides */
html,
body {
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}

body {
    min-width: 320px;
}

.navbar .container-xl {
    gap: 10px;
}

.navbar-brand {
    min-width: 0;
}

.navbar-brand-text {
    min-width: 0;
}

.navbar-collapse {
    overflow: visible;
}

.dropdown-menu {
    max-width: calc(100vw - 24px);
}

.content-wrapper {
    align-items: stretch;
}

.main-content {
    min-width: 0;
}

.card,
.stat-card,
.list-group-item,
.modal-content {
    min-width: 0;
}

.card {
    height: auto;
}

.table {
    vertical-align: middle;
}

.table th,
.table td {
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.table td {
    max-width: 280px;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.btn,
.dropdown-item,
.nav-link {
    white-space: normal;
}

.btn-group,
.btn-toolbar,
.d-flex {
    min-width: 0;
}

.form-control,
.form-check-input {
    -webkit-appearance: auto;
    appearance: auto;
}

.form-select {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
}

input,
textarea,
select {
    max-width: 100%;
}

.modal-dialog {
    width: auto;
}

.footer .row {
    display: flex;
}

.sidebar {
    min-width: 250px;
}

@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
    .navbar-collapse {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-blue) 0%, var(--secondary-blue) 100%);
        max-height: calc(100vh - 64px);
        overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .management-menu {
        min-width: 100% !important;
    }

    .management-menu-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
    }
}

@media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 991.98px) {
    .col-md-6 {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
        width: 50%;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .content-wrapper {
        display: block !important;
    }

    .sidebar {
        position: static !important;
        display: block !important;
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: none !important;
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: auto;
        max-height: 48vh;
        overflow-y: auto;
        border-right: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        box-shadow: none;
        padding: 10px 0;
    }

    .sidebar-profile {
        flex-direction: row;
        text-align: left;
        padding: 0 14px 10px;
    }

    .sidebar-item,
    .sidebar-group summary {
        padding: 10px 14px;
    }

    .sidebar-subitem {
        padding-left: 38px !important;
    }

    .main-content > .container-xl,
    .container-xl {
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .main-content .d-flex.justify-content-between,
    .main-content .d-flex.align-items-center.justify-content-between,
    .main-content .d-flex.align-items-center {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 12px;
    }

    .main-content .d-flex.justify-content-between > *,
    .main-content .d-flex.align-items-center.justify-content-between > * {
        min-width: 0;
    }

    .main-content h1 {
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .table-responsive {
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 8px;
    }

    .modal-dialog.modal-lg,
    .modal-dialog.modal-xl {
        max-width: calc(100vw - 16px);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 575.98px) {
    html {
        font-size: 100%;
    }

    .navbar-brand img {
        height: 34px;
    }

    .navbar-brand-text {
        display: flex;
    }

    .navbar-brand-text span:first-child {
        font-size: 0.68rem;
    }

    .navbar-brand-text span:last-child {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }

    .container,
    .container-sm,
    .container-md,
    .container-lg,
    .container-xl,
    .container-xxl {
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .hero-gradient .d-flex,
    .container-xl > .d-flex.justify-content-between,
    .container-xl > .d-flex.align-items-center.justify-content-between {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 12px;
    }

    .hero-gradient h1,
    .display-3 {
        font-size: 1.65rem !important;
        line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .section-title,
    h1 {
        font-size: 1.45rem !important;
        line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .btn {
        min-height: 40px;
        max-width: 100%;
    }

    .btn-lg {
        width: auto;
    }

    .d-grid .btn,
    .w-100.btn {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .btn-group {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn-group > .btn {
        flex: 1 1 auto;
    }

    .modal-dialog {
        margin: 8px;
        max-width: calc(100vw - 16px);
    }

    .modal-body {
        max-height: calc(100vh - 150px);
        overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .footer .row {
        gap: 12px;
    }
}

/* Final sidebar collapse overrides */
@media (min-width: 769px) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        width: 250px !important;
        min-width: 250px !important;
        max-width: 250px;
        position: sticky;
        top: calc(var(--sgpi-global-notice-height, 0px) + 86px);
        align-self: flex-start;
        max-height: calc(100vh - var(--sgpi-global-notice-height, 0px) - 86px);
        min-height: calc(100vh - var(--sgpi-global-notice-height, 0px) - 86px);
        overflow-y: auto;
        transition: width 0.24s ease, min-width 0.24s ease, max-width 0.24s ease, box-shadow 0.24s ease;
    }

    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed {
        width: 74px !important;
        min-width: 74px !important;
        max-width: 74px;
    }

    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-expanded {
        width: 250px !important;
        min-width: 250px !important;
        max-width: 250px;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-profile {
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-profile > div,
    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-section-title,
    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-item span,
    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-group summary span,
    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-group summary .bi-chevron-down {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-item,
    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-group summary {
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 0;
        padding-left: 0 !important;
        padding-right: 0 !important;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-subitem {
        display: none !important;
    }
}

/* Experimental interface refresh */
:root {
    --app-shell-bg: #f4f7fb;
    --app-topbar-height: 78px;
    --app-sidebar-blue: #082a5b;
    --app-sidebar-blue-deep: #06214a;
    --app-card-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.08);
    --app-card-border: rgba(27, 57, 106, 0.12);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --app-shell-bg: #101827;
    --app-card-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
    --app-card-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}

body {
    background: var(--app-shell-bg);
}

.navbar {
    min-height: var(--app-topbar-height);
    padding: 0.75rem 0;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-blue) 0%, #0c4ca3 100%);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(3, 28, 68, 0.18);
}

.navbar .container-xl {
    max-width: none;
    padding-left: 24px;
    padding-right: 24px;
}

.navbar-brand {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    min-width: 300px;
}

.navbar-brand img {
    height: 52px;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2));
}

.navbar-brand-text span:first-child,
.navbar-brand-text span:last-child {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0;
}

.global-search-shell {
    flex: 1 1 520px;
    max-width: 560px;
    position: relative;
}

.global-search {
    align-items: center;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: #fff;
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    min-height: 46px;
    padding: 0 12px 0 16px;
    width: 100%;
}

.global-search input {
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    color: #fff;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    outline: 0;
}

.global-search input::placeholder {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76);
}

.global-search kbd {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    border-radius: 6px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 4px 8px;
}

.global-search-results {
    background: var(--bs-body-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.24);
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
    left: 0;
    max-height: min(560px, calc(100vh - 110px));
    overflow: auto;
    padding: 8px;
    position: absolute;
    right: 0;
    top: calc(100% + 9px);
    z-index: 1080;
}

.global-search-heading {
    color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 750;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    padding: 7px 10px 5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.global-search-result {
    align-items: center;
    border-radius: 9px;
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
    display: flex;
    gap: 11px;
    padding: 10px;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.global-search-result:hover,
.global-search-result.active {
    background: rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb), 0.1);
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
}

.global-search-result-icon {
    align-items: center;
    background: rgba(var(--bs-primary-rgb), 0.12);
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: var(--bs-primary);
    display: inline-flex;
    flex: 0 0 38px;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    height: 38px;
    justify-content: center;
}

.global-search-result-copy {
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
}

.global-search-result-copy strong,
.global-search-result-copy small {
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.global-search-result-copy small {
    color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
    font-size: 0.78rem;
}

.global-search-result-action {
    color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 650;
}

.global-search-help {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
    color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-top: 6px;
    padding: 9px 10px 3px;
}

.global-search-help kbd {
    background: var(--bs-tertiary-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: var(--bs-body-color);
    margin-right: 3px;
    padding: 1px 4px;
}

.navbar-collapse {
    flex-grow: 0;
}

.navbar-nav {
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
}

.navbar .nav-link {
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86) !important;
    font-weight: 650;
    min-height: 42px;
}

.navbar .nav-link:hover,
.navbar .nav-link.active {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    color: #fff !important;
}

.nav-icon-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.nav-icon-link {
    align-items: center;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    display: inline-flex !important;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 42px;
    padding: 8px !important;
    position: relative;
}

.nav-icon-link i {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
}

.nav-icon-badge {
    align-items: center;
    background: #ef4444;
    border: 2px solid var(--primary-blue);
    border-radius: 999px;
    color: #fff;
    display: inline-flex;
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    height: 20px;
    justify-content: center;
    min-width: 20px;
    padding: 0 5px;
    position: absolute;
    right: 1px;
    top: 0;
}

.notification-menu {
    border: 1px solid var(--app-card-border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(9, 24, 51, 0.18);
    min-width: 380px;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 0;
}

.notification-menu-header {
    align-items: center;
    background: var(--surface-bg);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    display: flex;
    gap: 16px;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 16px;
}

.notification-menu-header strong,
.notification-menu-header small {
    display: block;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.notification-menu-header strong {
    color: var(--text-dark);
    font-size: 1rem;
}

.notification-menu-header small {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    margin-top: 4px;
}

.notification-list {
    background: var(--surface-bg);
    max-height: min(460px, calc(100vh - 150px));
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.notification-item {
    align-items: flex-start;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    display: grid;
    gap: 12px;
    grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr;
    padding: 14px 16px;
}

.activity-notification-item {
    background: transparent;
    border-left: 0;
    border-right: 0;
    border-top: 0;
    text-align: left;
    width: 100%;
}

.activity-notification-item:hover {
    background: rgba(27, 57, 106, 0.06);
}

.activity-notification-item.is-unread {
    background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08);
}

.activity-notification-item.is-unread strong::after {
    background: #2563eb;
    border-radius: 999px;
    content: '';
    display: inline-block;
    height: 7px;
    margin-left: 7px;
    vertical-align: 1px;
    width: 7px;
}

/* Skeleton loader global */
:root {
    --skeleton-base: #e5ebf3;
    --skeleton-highlight: #f9fbfe;
    --skeleton-accent: rgba(27, 57, 106, 0.08);
}

[data-theme="dark"] {
    --skeleton-base: #243449;
    --skeleton-highlight: #3a4d66;
    --skeleton-accent: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.1);
}

.skeleton-line,
.skeleton-avatar,
.skeleton-pill,
.skeleton-button,
.skeleton-card-media,
.skeleton-actions span {
    animation: skeleton-shimmer 1.35s ease-in-out infinite;
    background: linear-gradient(
        105deg,
        var(--skeleton-base) 24%,
        var(--skeleton-highlight) 44%,
        var(--skeleton-base) 66%
    );
    background-size: 240% 100%;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}

.skeleton-line {
    border-radius: 7px;
    display: block;
    height: var(--skeleton-height, 0.85rem);
    max-width: 100%;
    width: var(--skeleton-width, 100%);
}

.skeleton-block {
    animation: skeleton-appear 220ms ease-out both;
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--surface-bg), var(--skeleton-accent));
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: 14px;
    display: grid;
    gap: 12px;
    min-height: 132px;
    padding: 20px;
}

.skeleton-block-heading,
.skeleton-card-heading {
    align-items: center;
    display: grid;
    gap: 12px;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
}

.skeleton-block-heading > div,
.skeleton-card-heading > div,
.skeleton-table-copy {
    display: grid;
    gap: 8px;
}

.skeleton-avatar {
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: block;
    height: 42px;
    width: 42px;
}

.skeleton-avatar-sm {
    height: 34px;
    width: 34px;
}

.skeleton-card-grid {
    display: grid;
    gap: 16px;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
    padding: 8px 0;
    width: 100%;
}

.skeleton-card {
    animation: skeleton-appear 260ms ease-out both;
    background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--surface-bg), var(--skeleton-accent));
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: 14px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 35, 65, 0.05);
    display: grid;
    gap: 13px;
    min-height: 210px;
    padding: 18px;
}

.skeleton-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 45ms; }
.skeleton-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 90ms; }

.skeleton-card-media {
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: block;
    height: 62px;
    margin: 2px 0;
    opacity: 0.72;
    width: 100%;
}

.skeleton-card-footer {
    align-items: center;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-top: 8px;
}

.skeleton-pill {
    border-radius: 999px;
    display: block;
    height: 26px;
    width: 82px;
}

.skeleton-button {
    border-radius: 8px;
    display: block;
    height: 32px;
    width: 92px;
}

.skeleton-table {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0;
    padding: 0;
    width: 100%;
}

.skeleton-table-row {
    align-items: center;
    animation: skeleton-appear 220ms ease-out both;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    display: grid;
    gap: 14px;
    grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(150px, 1.4fr) minmax(100px, 1fr) 90px 104px;
    min-height: 70px;
    padding: 12px 8px;
}

.skeleton-table-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
.skeleton-table-row:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 35ms; }
.skeleton-table-row:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 70ms; }
.skeleton-table-row:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 105ms; }
.skeleton-table-row:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 140ms; }

.skeleton-actions {
    display: flex;
    gap: 7px;
    justify-content: flex-end;
}

.skeleton-actions span {
    border-radius: 7px;
    display: block;
    height: 30px;
    width: 30px;
}

html::before {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #60a5fa, #1b396a, transparent);
    content: '';
    height: 3px;
    left: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    position: fixed;
    right: 0;
    top: 0;
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    transition: opacity 160ms ease;
    z-index: 12000;
}

html.sgpi-api-loading::before {
    animation: skeleton-request-progress 1.15s ease-in-out infinite;
    opacity: 1;
}

@keyframes skeleton-shimmer {
    from { background-position: 100% 0; }
    to { background-position: -120% 0; }
}

@keyframes skeleton-appear {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes skeleton-request-progress {
    from { transform: translateX(-100%); }
    to { transform: translateX(100%); }
}

@media (max-width: 767.98px) {
    .skeleton-table-row {
        grid-template-columns: 34px 1fr 76px;
    }

    .skeleton-table-row > :nth-child(3),
    .skeleton-table-row > :nth-child(5) {
        display: none;
    }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .skeleton-line,
    .skeleton-avatar,
    .skeleton-pill,
    .skeleton-button,
    .skeleton-card-media,
    .skeleton-actions span,
    .skeleton-block,
    .skeleton-card,
    .skeleton-table-row,
    html.sgpi-api-loading::before {
        animation: none;
    }
}

/* Dark-mode compatibility layer and standalone repository */
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
    --bs-body-bg: var(--app-shell-bg);
    --bs-body-color: var(--text-dark);
    --bs-emphasis-color: #ffffff;
    --bs-secondary-color: var(--text-muted);
    --bs-secondary-bg: var(--soft-bg);
    --bs-tertiary-bg: #202a3d;
    --bs-border-color: var(--border-color);
    --bs-heading-color: #f3f7fd;
    --bs-link-color: #9fc7ff;
    --bs-link-hover-color: #c7ddff;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] body,
:root[data-theme="dark"] main,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .main-content {
    color: var(--text-dark);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] h1,
:root[data-theme="dark"] h2,
:root[data-theme="dark"] h3,
:root[data-theme="dark"] h4,
:root[data-theme="dark"] h5,
:root[data-theme="dark"] h6,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card-title,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .form-label,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .form-check-label {
    color: #f3f7fd;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .hero-gradient h1,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .hero-gradient h2,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .modal-header h1,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .modal-header h2,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .modal-header h3,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .modal-header h4,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .modal-header h5,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .modal-header h6,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card-header.bg-primary h1,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card-header.bg-primary h2,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card-header.bg-primary h3,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card-header.bg-primary h4,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card-header.bg-primary h5,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card-header.bg-primary h6 {
    color: #fff !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .bg-white,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card-header.bg-white,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .card-footer.bg-white,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .modal-content,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .modal-body,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .modal-footer,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .accordion-item,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .accordion-button,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .offcanvas,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .list-group-item {
    background-color: var(--surface-bg) !important;
    border-color: var(--border-color) !important;
    color: var(--text-dark) !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .accordion-button:not(.collapsed),
:root[data-theme="dark"] .accordion-button:hover {
    background-color: var(--soft-bg) !important;
    color: #fff !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .form-control,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .form-select,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .form-control:focus,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .form-select:focus {
    background-color: #172033;
    border-color: #4a5a74;
    color: #f3f7fd;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .form-control::placeholder,
:root[data-theme="dark"] textarea::placeholder,
:root[data-theme="dark"] input::placeholder {
    color: #91a1b8 !important;
    opacity: 1;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .form-select option {
    background: #172033;
    color: #f3f7fd;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] input:-webkit-autofill,
:root[data-theme="dark"] input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
:root[data-theme="dark"] input:-webkit-autofill:focus {
    -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px #172033 inset;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: #f3f7fd;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .form-text,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .text-body-secondary,
:root[data-theme="dark"] small {
    color: var(--text-muted);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .text-primary {
    color: #9fc7ff !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn-outline-primary {
    border-color: #78a7e8 !important;
    color: #a9ceff !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn-outline-primary:hover,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn-outline-primary:focus-visible {
    background: #345d92 !important;
    color: #fff !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn-outline-danger {
    border-color: #f27786;
    color: #ff9ca8;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn-outline-danger:hover,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .btn-outline-danger:focus-visible {
    background: #b93649;
    color: #fff;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .text-bg-light,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .badge.bg-light {
    background-color: #dfe8f5 !important;
    color: #172033 !important;
    border-color: #b9c8da !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .border,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .border-top,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .border-bottom,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .border-start,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .border-end,
:root[data-theme="dark"] hr,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .dropdown-divider {
    border-color: var(--border-color) !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .progress {
    background-color: #344158;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .page-link {
    background: var(--surface-bg);
    border-color: var(--border-color);
    color: #a9ceff;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .page-item.active .page-link,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .page-link:hover {
    background: #345d92;
    border-color: #78a7e8;
    color: #fff;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .page-item.disabled .page-link {
    background: #151e2e;
    color: #687890;
}

.repository-shell {
    min-height: 100vh;
}

@media (min-width: 769px) {
    .repository-shell .navbar-authenticated {
        margin-left: 0 !important;
        width: 100% !important;
    }

    .repository-shell .navbar-authenticated .navbar-brand {
        display: flex !important;
        min-width: 250px;
    }

    .repository-shell .navbar-sidebar-toggle,
    .repository-shell .navbar-mobile-emblem,
    .repository-shell .global-search-shell {
        display: none !important;
    }
}

.repository-content {
    max-width: 1500px;
}

.repository-hero-kicker,
.repository-section-kicker {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.45rem;
    font-size: 0.76rem;
    font-weight: 750;
    letter-spacing: 0.09em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.repository-hero-kicker {
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
    margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}

.repository-section-kicker {
    color: var(--text-muted);
}

.repository-toolbar {
    background: var(--surface-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: 14px;
    box-shadow: var(--app-card-shadow);
    margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
    padding: 1.25rem;
}

.repository-toolbar-heading {
    align-items: center;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.repository-results-summary {
    background: var(--soft-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: 999px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.repository-search-field {
    position: relative;
}

.repository-search-field > i {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    left: 1.6rem;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    z-index: 2;
}

.repository-search-field .form-control {
    padding-left: 2.7rem;
}

.repository-document-card {
    overflow: hidden;
}

.repository-document-card .card-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 290px;
    padding: 1.35rem;
}

.repository-card-badges,
.repository-tag-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 0.45rem;
}

.repository-card-badges {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.repository-category-badge {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 10%, var(--surface-bg));
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 24%, var(--border-color));
    color: var(--primary-blue);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .repository-category-badge {
    background: #243653;
    border-color: #49698f;
    color: #c6ddff;
}

.repository-document-card .card-title {
    line-height: 1.35;
    margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
}

.repository-document-card .card-text {
    display: -webkit-box;
    line-height: 1.55;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
}

.repository-tag-list {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.repository-tag-list .badge {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--tag-color) 82%, #1f2937);
    color: #fff;
}

.repository-card-meta {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    color: var(--text-muted);
    display: grid;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    gap: 0.45rem;
    margin-top: auto;
    padding-top: 0.9rem;
}

.repository-card-meta span {
    align-items: flex-start;
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
}

.repository-card-meta .repository-file-missing {
    color: #b45309;
    font-weight: 650;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .repository-card-meta .repository-file-missing {
    color: #f8d46b;
}

.repository-card-actions {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--soft-bg) 72%, var(--surface-bg));
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color) !important;
    padding: 1rem;
}

.repository-empty-state {
    align-items: center;
    background: var(--surface-bg);
    border: 1px dashed var(--border-color);
    border-radius: 14px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 260px;
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
}

.repository-empty-state > i {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 2.4rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.repository-empty-state h2,
.repository-empty-state h3 {
    color: var(--text-dark);
}

.repository-error-state > i {
    color: #dc5365;
}

.repository-detail-hero {
    padding: 1.4rem 0;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .repository-reader {
    background: #111827;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .repository-shell .navbar-authenticated .navbar-sidebar-toggle,
    .repository-shell .navbar-authenticated .navbar-mobile-emblem {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .repository-shell .navbar-authenticated .navbar-brand {
        display: flex !important;
        margin-right: 3.5rem;
    }

    .repository-shell .navbar-authenticated > .container-xl > .navbar-toggler {
        display: inline-flex !important;
    }

    .repository-shell .navbar-authenticated .navbar-collapse.show {
        display: block !important;
    }

    .repository-shell .navbar-authenticated .navbar-collapse:not(.show) {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .repository-toolbar-heading {
        align-items: flex-start;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    .repository-upload-action .btn {
        width: 100%;
    }

    .page-image-header,
    .hero-gradient.repository-page-hero {
        margin-top: 12px;
        min-height: 220px;
        padding: 42px 12px !important;
        width: calc(100% - 24px);
    }
}

.sgpi-page-transition {
    align-items: center;
    backdrop-filter: blur(13px) saturate(120%);
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, rgba(26, 103, 213, 0.13), transparent 34%),
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--soft-bg) 90%, transparent);
    display: flex;
    inset: 0;
    justify-content: center;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    position: fixed;
    transition: opacity 150ms ease;
    z-index: 11950;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-panel {
    align-items: center;
    background:
        linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-bg) 98%, #fff), color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-bg) 92%, #dcecff));
    border: 1px solid rgba(71, 130, 209, 0.2);
    border-radius: 30px;
    box-shadow:
        0 30px 90px rgba(4, 35, 78, 0.25),
        0 8px 28px rgba(20, 94, 190, 0.12),
        inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
    display: grid;
    gap: 32px;
    grid-template-columns: 142px minmax(240px, 290px);
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 30px 38px 30px 28px;
    position: relative;
    transform: translateY(14px) scale(0.94);
    transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
}

.sgpi-page-transition-panel::before {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #2382ff, #69b1ff, transparent);
    content: '';
    height: 4px;
    left: 0;
    position: absolute;
    right: 0;
    top: 0;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-panel::after {
    background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(64, 147, 255, 0.18), transparent 68%);
    content: '';
    height: 220px;
    left: -72px;
    pointer-events: none;
    position: absolute;
    top: -78px;
    width: 220px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-mark {
    align-items: center;
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98) 0 42%, rgba(221, 237, 255, 0.92) 43% 61%, rgba(50, 137, 255, 0.12) 62% 100%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(46, 128, 235, 0.24);
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow:
        0 0 0 10px rgba(46, 128, 235, 0.06),
        0 18px 42px rgba(13, 83, 177, 0.26),
        inset 0 0 30px rgba(71, 151, 255, 0.13);
    display: flex;
    height: 122px;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    width: 122px;
    z-index: 1;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-logo {
    align-items: center;
    animation: sgpi-loader-logo-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(4, 45, 100, 0.2);
    display: flex;
    height: 78px;
    justify-content: center;
    position: relative;
    width: 78px;
    z-index: 3;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-logo img {
    height: 66px;
    object-fit: contain;
    width: 66px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-orbit {
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: absolute;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-orbit-outer {
    animation: sgpi-loader-orbit 1.15s linear infinite;
    border: 4px solid transparent;
    border-bottom-color: #0b5fcf;
    border-right-color: #54a2ff;
    inset: -9px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-orbit-inner {
    animation: sgpi-loader-orbit-reverse 0.95s linear infinite;
    border: 2px dashed rgba(24, 118, 239, 0.7);
    inset: 10px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-spark {
    animation: sgpi-loader-spark 1.25s ease-in-out infinite;
    background: #43a0ff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px #43a0ff;
    height: 7px;
    position: absolute;
    width: 7px;
    z-index: 5;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-spark-one {
    right: 7px;
    top: 17px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-spark-two {
    animation-delay: 0.25s;
    bottom: 11px;
    left: 17px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-spark-three {
    animation-delay: 0.5s;
    left: 5px;
    top: 40px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-copy {
    display: grid;
    gap: 6px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-copy strong {
    color: var(--text-dark);
    font-size: 1.28rem;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-copy small {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 0.84rem;
    line-height: 1.45;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-eyebrow {
    color: #0d65d5;
    font-size: 0.69rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-progress {
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 10%, var(--soft-bg));
    border-radius: 999px;
    display: block;
    height: 7px;
    margin-top: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-progress i {
    animation: sgpi-loader-progress 1.05s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1) infinite;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0757c6, #2382ff 55%, #79bdff);
    border-radius: inherit;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(35, 130, 255, 0.55);
    display: block;
    height: 100%;
    width: 46%;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-dots {
    display: flex;
    gap: 5px;
    margin-top: 6px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-dots i {
    animation: sgpi-loader-dot 1s ease-in-out infinite;
    background: #2f85ee;
    border-radius: 50%;
    height: 5px;
    opacity: 0.35;
    width: 5px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-dots i:nth-child(2) {
    animation-delay: 0.14s;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-dots i:nth-child(3) {
    animation-delay: 0.28s;
}

@keyframes sgpi-loader-orbit {
    to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes sgpi-loader-orbit-reverse {
    to { transform: rotate(-360deg); }
}

@keyframes sgpi-loader-logo-pulse {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(0.96); }
    50% { transform: scale(1.04); }
}

@keyframes sgpi-loader-spark {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.25; transform: scale(0.65); }
    50% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.2); }
}

@keyframes sgpi-loader-dot {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.25; transform: translateY(0); }
    50% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-3px); }
}

@keyframes sgpi-loader-progress {
    from { transform: translateX(-115%); }
    to { transform: translateX(235%); }
}

html.sgpi-page-leaving .sgpi-page-transition,
html.sgpi-page-entering .sgpi-page-transition {
    opacity: 1;
}

html.sgpi-page-leaving .sgpi-page-transition {
    pointer-events: all;
}

html.sgpi-page-leaving .sgpi-page-transition-panel,
html.sgpi-page-entering .sgpi-page-transition-panel {
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
}

html.sgpi-page-leaving .main-content {
    opacity: 0.55;
    transform: translateY(5px);
    transition: opacity 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease;
}

html.sgpi-page-entering .main-content {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
}

html.sgpi-page-entering.sgpi-page-entered .main-content {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
    transition: opacity 280ms ease, transform 320ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1);
}

html.sgpi-page-entering.sgpi-page-entered .sgpi-page-transition {
    opacity: 0;
    transition-delay: 80ms;
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .sgpi-page-transition-panel {
        gap: 18px;
        grid-template-columns: 94px minmax(0, 1fr);
        margin: 0 18px;
        padding: 24px 20px;
        width: calc(100% - 36px);
    }

    .sgpi-page-transition-mark {
        height: 86px;
        width: 86px;
    }

    .sgpi-page-transition-logo {
        height: 58px;
        width: 58px;
    }

    .sgpi-page-transition-logo img {
        height: 49px;
        width: 49px;
    }

    .sgpi-page-transition-copy strong {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .sgpi-page-transition-orbit,
    .sgpi-page-transition-progress i,
    .sgpi-page-transition-logo,
    .sgpi-page-transition-spark,
    .sgpi-page-transition-dots i {
        animation: none;
    }

    .sgpi-page-transition-progress i {
        width: 70%;
    }
}

/* Gestion de semestres */
.semester-stat-icon {
    align-items: center;
    background: rgba(27, 57, 106, 0.1);
    border-radius: 13px;
    color: var(--primary-blue);
    display: inline-flex;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    height: 48px;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 48px;
}

.semester-movement {
    align-items: center;
    background: var(--soft-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
}

.semester-search-results {
    background: var(--surface-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(15, 35, 65, 0.12);
    max-height: 270px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}

.semester-search-results:empty {
    display: none;
}

.semester-search-result {
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    color: var(--text-dark);
    display: block;
    padding: 11px 13px;
    text-align: left;
    width: 100%;
}

.semester-search-result:last-child {
    border-bottom: 0;
}

.semester-search-result:hover {
    background: rgba(27, 57, 106, 0.07);
}

.semester-search-result small {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    display: block;
    margin-top: 2px;
}

::view-transition-old(root) {
    animation: sgpi-view-out 110ms ease-out both;
}

::view-transition-new(root) {
    animation: sgpi-view-in 220ms cubic-bezier(.2, .8, .2, 1) both;
}

@keyframes sgpi-view-out {
    from { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    to { opacity: 0.35; transform: translateY(4px); }
}

@keyframes sgpi-view-in {
    from { opacity: 0.35; transform: translateY(-4px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    ::view-transition-old(root),
    ::view-transition-new(root) {
        animation-duration: 1ms;
    }
}

.notification-item:last-child {
    border-bottom: 0;
}

.notification-icon {
    align-items: center;
    background: rgba(27, 57, 106, 0.1);
    border-radius: 999px;
    color: var(--primary-blue);
    display: inline-flex;
    height: 42px;
    justify-content: center;

}

.notification-item-warning .notification-icon {

}

.notification-item-danger .notification-icon {

}

.notification-item-success .notification-icon {

.notification-item strong {

.notification-item p {

.notification-item small {

.notification-empty {

.user-nav-link {

.user-nav-link .profile-thumb {

.user-nav-name {

/* Institutional shell inspired by the approved dashboard proposal */
:root {
    --proposal-sidebar-width: 300px;
    --proposal-sidebar-collapsed: 86px;
    --proposal-topbar-height: 102px;
    --proposal-navy: #062b60;
    --proposal-navy-deep: #031f49;
    --proposal-blue: #0e5fd0;
}

.sidebar-brand {
    align-items: center;
    color: #fff;
    display: flex;
    gap: 13px;
    margin: 0 8px 26px;
    min-height: 76px;
    padding: 4px 2px 20px;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.sidebar-brand img {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24));
    flex: 0 0 58px;
    height: 58px;
    object-fit: contain;
    width: 58px;
}

.sidebar-brand div {
    display: grid;
    line-height: 1.22;
}

.sidebar-brand strong {

    font-size: 0.96rem;
}

.sidebar-brand small {

}

.sidebar-online {

}

.sidebar-online i {

}

.sidebar-collapse-control {

.sidebar-collapse-control:hover {

.navbar-sidebar-toggle {

.dashboard-hero h1 {

.dashboard-hero-line {

.dashboard-action-panel {

@media (min-width: 769px) {
    body {
        min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .navbar {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.97);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.09);
        margin-left: var(--proposal-sidebar-width);
        min-height: var(--proposal-topbar-height);
        padding: 0 1.5rem;
        width: calc(100% - var(--proposal-sidebar-width));
        z-index: 1035;
    }

    .navbar .container-xl {
        gap: 0;
        padding-left: 12px;
        padding-right: 12px;
    }

    .navbar-authenticated .navbar-brand {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .global-search-shell {
        margin-right: auto;
        max-width: 500px;
    }

    .global-search {
        background: #f8faff;
        border-color: #d7e0ed;
        color: #17345f;
        min-height: 52px;
    }

    .global-search input {
        color: #17345f;
    }

    .global-search input::placeholder {
        color: #71809a;
    }

    .global-search kbd {
        background: #fff;
        border-color: #dce4ef;
        color: #71809a;
    }

    .navbar .nav-link {
        color: #18355e !important;
    }

    .navbar .nav-link:hover,
    .navbar .nav-link.active {
        background: #edf3fb;
        color: #072f68 !important;
    }

    .user-nav-name strong {
        color: #071f43;
    }

    .user-nav-name small {
        color: #71809a;
        opacity: 1;
    }

    .nav-icon-badge {
        border-color: #fff;
    }

    .content-wrapper {
        padding-left: var(--proposal-sidebar-width);
    }

    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--proposal-navy-deep) 0%, var(--proposal-navy) 58%, #043d82 100%) !important;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        inset: 0 auto 0 0;
        max-height: none;
        max-width: var(--proposal-sidebar-width);
        min-height: 100vh;
        min-width: var(--proposal-sidebar-width) !important;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding: 24px 20px 18px;
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        width: var(--proposal-sidebar-width) !important;
        z-index: 1040;
    }

    .sidebar-profile {
        margin-bottom: 20px;
        padding: 0 6px 24px;
    }

    .sidebar-profile-photo {
        height: 58px;
        width: 58px;
    }

    .sidebar-item,
    .sidebar-group summary {
        min-height: 52px;
        padding: 13px 16px;
    }

    .sidebar-item.active,
    .sidebar-group[open] summary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0757c5 0%, #126bdc 100%);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 50, 128, 0.26);
    }

    .sidebar-footer-brand {
        margin-top: auto;
    }

    html.sgpi-sidebar-collapsed .navbar {
        margin-left: var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed);
        width: calc(100% - var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed));
    }

    html.sgpi-sidebar-collapsed .content-wrapper {
        padding-left: var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed);
    }

    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed {
        max-width: var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed);
        min-width: var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed) !important;
        padding-left: 10px;
        padding-right: 10px;
        width: var(--proposal-sidebar-collapsed) !important;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand div,
    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-online,
    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-footer-brand {
        display: none;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand {
        justify-content: center;
        margin-left: 0;
        margin-right: 0;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand img {
        height: 48px;
        width: 48px;
    }

    .sidebar#appSidebar.sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-collapse-control {
        transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .main-content {
        min-width: 0;
        width: 100%;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) and (min-width: 769px) {
    .navbar .nav-link {
        font-size: 0;
        min-width: 42px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .navbar .nav-link i {
        font-size: 1.1rem;
    }

    .user-nav-name {
        display: none;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .sidebar-brand {
        margin-top: 42px;
    }

    .navbar-sidebar-toggle {
        display: none;
    }

    .dashboard-action-panel {
        align-items: flex-start;
        grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr);
        padding: 22px;
    }

    .dashboard-action-icon {
        font-size: 2.2rem;
        height: 64px;
        width: 64px;
    }

    .dashboard-action-link {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .dashboard-stat-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    }

    .dashboard-stat-icon {
        height: 60px;
        width: 60px;
    }
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar {
    background: #18283f;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-sidebar-toggle,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar .nav-link,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .user-nav-name strong {
    color: #e7eef9 !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-sidebar-toggle:hover,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar .nav-link:hover,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar .nav-link.active,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar .nav-link.show {
    background: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.14) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar .dropdown-toggle::after {
    border-top-color: currentColor;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .global-search {
    background: #111d30;
    border-color: #3a4b64;
    color: #e7eef9;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .global-search input {
    color: #f1f5f9;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .global-search input::placeholder {
    color: #91a1b8;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .global-search kbd {
    background: #f8fafc;
    border-color: #d5dce6;
    color: #334155;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .user-nav-name small {
    color: #a9b7ca;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .nav-icon-badge {
    border-color: #18283f;
}

@media (min-width: 769px) {
    .navbar-authenticated .navbar-brand {
        display: none !important;
    }
}

/* Loader de navegación: emblema circular y etiqueta */
.sgpi-page-transition {
    backdrop-filter: blur(9px);
    background:
        radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(35, 130, 255, 0.11), transparent 25%),
        color-mix(in srgb, var(--soft-bg) 86%, transparent);
}

.sgpi-page-transition-panel {
    align-items: center;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 22px;
    grid-template-columns: none;
    overflow: visible;
    padding: 16px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-panel::before,
.sgpi-page-transition-panel::after {
    display: none;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-mark {
    height: 126px;
    width: 126px;
}

.sgpi-page-transition-label {
    color: var(--text-dark);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 750;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-bg) 75%, transparent);
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .sgpi-page-transition-panel {
        display: flex;
        gap: 18px;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 12px;
        width: auto;
    }

    .sgpi-page-transition-mark {
        height: 108px;
        width: 108px;
    }

    .sgpi-page-transition-label {
        font-size: 0.92rem;
    }
}

/* Public navigation does not reserve space for the authenticated sidebar. */
.navbar-public {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.97);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.1);
    margin-left: 0 !important;
    min-height: 82px;
    padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    width: 100% !important;
}

.navbar-public .container-xl {
    gap: 1.5rem;
    max-width: 1640px;
}

.navbar-public .navbar-brand {
    color: #102f59 !important;
    gap: 14px;
}

.navbar-public .navbar-brand img {
    filter: drop-shadow(0 5px 10px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.15));
    height: 58px;
}

.navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:first-child {
    color: #45566f;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:last-child {
    color: #102f59;
    font-size: 1rem;
}

.navbar-public .nav-link {
    border-radius: 10px;
    color: #18355e !important;
    font-weight: 650;
    padding: 0.72rem 0.9rem !important;
}

.navbar-public .nav-link:hover,
.navbar-public .nav-link.active {
    background: #edf3fb;
    color: #072f68 !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public {
    background: rgba(23, 32, 51, 0.98);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.26);
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-brand,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:first-child,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:last-child,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .nav-link {
    color: #eaf2ff !important;
}

:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .nav-link:hover,
:root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .nav-link.active {
    background: rgba(147, 197, 253, 0.13);
    color: #ffffff !important;
}

@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
    .navbar-public {
        min-height: 72px;
        padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
    }

    .navbar-public .container-xl {
        gap: 0.75rem;
        position: relative;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-brand img {
        height: 48px;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:first-child {
        display: none;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-brand-text span:last-child {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-toggler {
        align-items: center;
        background: #eef4fb;
        border: 1px solid #d7e2ef;
        border-radius: 10px;
        display: inline-flex !important;
        height: 44px;
        justify-content: center;
        margin-left: auto;
        padding: 0;
        position: absolute;
        right: 0;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        width: 44px;
        z-index: 2;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-toggler-icon {
        filter: brightness(0) saturate(100%) invert(18%) sepia(36%) saturate(1660%) hue-rotate(177deg);
        height: 1.25rem;
        width: 1.25rem;
    }

    .navbar-public .navbar-collapse {
        background: #ffffff;
        border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        box-shadow: 0 14px 26px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.14);
        padding: 0.6rem;
    }

    :root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-toggler-icon {
        filter: brightness(0) invert(1);
    }

    :root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-toggler {
        background: #24324a;
        border-color: #41516b;
    }

    :root[data-theme="dark"] .navbar-public .navbar-collapse {
        background: #172033;
        border-color: #344158;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 575.98px) {
    .navbar-public .navbar-brand-text {
        display: none;
    }
}

/* Mobile data and interaction layer */
.mobile-details-control {
    display: none;
}

.users-mobile-options-toggle,
.users-mobile-actions,
.users-filter-label {
    display: none;
}

.navbar-mobile-emblem,
.dashboard-mobile-shortcuts {
    display: none;
}

.users-filter-section {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    body {
        overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .navbar-authenticated .container-xl {
        justify-content: flex-start;
        min-height: 48px;
        padding-left: 8px;
        padding-right: 8px;
        position: relative;
    }

    .navbar-authenticated .navbar-brand,
    .navbar-authenticated > .container-xl > .navbar-toggler,
    .navbar-authenticated .navbar-collapse {
        display: none !important;
    }

    body.sidebar-mobile-open {
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .main-content {
        overflow: clip;
    }

    .navbar-sidebar-toggle {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
        border-radius: 10px;
        color: #fff;
        display: inline-flex;
        flex: 0 0 46px;
        font-size: 1.55rem;
        height: 46px;
        margin: 0;
        width: 46px;
    }

    .navbar-sidebar-toggle:hover,
    .navbar-sidebar-toggle:focus-visible {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
        border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
        color: #fff;
        outline: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
        outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .navbar-sidebar-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] {
        background: #fff;
        border-color: #fff;
        color: var(--primary-blue) !important;
    }

    .navbar-mobile-emblem {
        align-items: center;
        display: inline-flex;
        height: 52px;
        justify-content: center;
        left: 50%;
        position: absolute;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        width: 58px;
    }

    .navbar-mobile-emblem img {
        filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24));
        height: 48px;
        object-fit: contain;
        width: 48px;
    }

    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar,
    .sidebar {
        bottom: 0;
        box-shadow: 12px 0 32px rgba(2, 18, 43, 0.3);
        display: block !important;
        left: 0;
        max-height: none;
        max-width: min(300px, calc(100vw - 48px)) !important;
        min-height: 0;
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overflow-y: auto;
        padding: 18px 14px !important;
        position: fixed !important;
        top: calc(var(--sgpi-global-notice-height, 0px) + 64px);
        transform: translateX(-105%);
        transition: transform 220ms ease;
        width: min(300px, calc(100vw - 48px)) !important;
        z-index: 1060;
    }

    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar.show,
    .sidebar.show {
        transform: translateX(0);
    }

    .sidebar-brand {
        margin-top: 0;
    }

    .sidebar-collapse-control {
        display: none;
    }

    .sidebar-mobile-backdrop {
        background: rgba(3, 18, 40, 0.54);
        border: 0;
        display: block;
        inset: calc(var(--sgpi-global-notice-height, 0px) + 64px) 0 0;
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
        position: fixed;
        transition: opacity 180ms ease;
        width: 100%;
        z-index: 1055;
    }

    .sidebar-mobile-backdrop.show {
        opacity: 1;
        pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .main-content > .container-xl {
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem !important;
        margin-top: 1.5rem !important;
    }

    .table-responsive {
        background: transparent;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 0;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        overflow: visible;
    }

    .table-responsive:focus {
        outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 48%, transparent);
        outline-offset: 3px;
    }

    .mobile-card-table {
        background: transparent !important;
        border: 0;
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-card-table thead {
        border: 0;
        clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
        clip-path: inset(50%);
        height: 1px;
        margin: -1px;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: 0;
        position: absolute;
        white-space: nowrap;
        width: 1px;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.85rem;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody tr {
        background: var(--surface-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 16px;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.1);
        display: grid;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        padding: 0.65rem 1rem 0.8rem;
        position: relative;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody tr::before {
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--primary-blue), var(--secondary-blue));
        content: "";
        height: 4px;
        inset: 0 0 auto;
        position: absolute;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody tr:hover {
        background: var(--surface-bg);
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td {
        align-items: start;
        background: transparent !important;
        border: 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        color: var(--text-dark);
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(7rem, 38%) minmax(0, 1fr);
        min-width: 0;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        padding: 0.72rem 0.15rem;
        text-align: right;
        white-space: normal;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-primary {
        align-items: start;
        border-bottom: 0;
        gap: 0.28rem;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        padding-bottom: 0.48rem;
        padding-top: 0.85rem;
        text-align: left;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-primary::before {
        color: var(--primary-blue);
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-primary {
        color: var(--text-dark);
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 750;
        line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-summary {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--soft-bg) 72%, transparent) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
        padding: 0.62rem 0.7rem;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-detail {
        display: none;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tr.mobile-details-expanded .mobile-table-detail {
        display: grid;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td::before {
        color: var(--text-muted);
        content: attr(data-label);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.035em;
        line-height: 1.35;
        text-align: left;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td:last-child {
        border-bottom: 0;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td[colspan],
    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-status-row td {
        display: block;
        padding: 1.25rem 0.5rem;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td[colspan]::before,
    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-status-row td::before,
    .mobile-card-table .mobile-cell-unlabelled::before {
        display: none;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-actions {
        align-items: center;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        margin-top: 0.25rem;
        order: 100;
        padding-top: 0.85rem;
        text-align: left;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-actions::before {
        margin-bottom: -0.2rem;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-actions .btn-group,
    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-actions > .d-flex {
        display: grid !important;
        gap: 0.45rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(42px, 1fr));
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-actions .btn {
        align-items: center;
        display: inline-flex;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 42px;
        min-width: 42px;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-details-control {
        border: 0;
        display: block;
        order: 90;
        padding: 0.45rem 0 0;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-details-control::before {
        display: none;
    }

    .mobile-details-toggle {
        align-items: center;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 8%, var(--surface-bg));
        border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 24%, var(--border-color));
        border-radius: 10px;
        color: var(--primary-blue);
        display: flex;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 750;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        justify-content: space-between;
        min-height: 42px;
        padding: 0.62rem 0.8rem;
        text-align: left;
        transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .mobile-details-toggle span {
        align-items: center;
        display: inline-flex;
        gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .mobile-details-toggle:hover,
    .mobile-details-toggle:focus-visible {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 14%, var(--surface-bg));
        border-color: var(--primary-blue);
        outline: 0;
    }

    .mobile-details-chevron {
        transition: transform 180ms ease;
    }

    .mobile-details-expanded .mobile-details-chevron {
        transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .mobile-card-table tr.mobile-details-expanded {
        box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.14);
    }

    .mobile-scroll-table {
        min-width: 720px;
    }

    .table-responsive.mobile-scroll-region {
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 10px;
        overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .row.g-3 > [class*="col-"],
    .row.g-2 > [class*="col-"] {
        min-width: 0;
    }

    .main-content .input-group {
        flex-wrap: nowrap;
    }

    .main-content .input-group .form-control {
        min-width: 0;
    }

    .main-content .pagination {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.3rem;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .main-content .page-link {
        align-items: center;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
        display: inline-flex;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 42px;
        min-width: 42px;
    }

    .modal-dialog,
    .modal-dialog.modal-lg,
    .modal-dialog.modal-xl {
        margin: 0.5rem;
        max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem);
    }

    .modal-content {
        max-height: calc(100dvh - 1rem);
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .modal-body {
        overflow-x: hidden;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overscroll-behavior: contain;
    }

    .modal-footer {
        background: var(--surface-bg);
        border-top-color: var(--border-color);
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
        position: sticky;
        bottom: 0;
    }

    .modal-footer .btn {
        margin: 0;
        min-height: 44px;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .dropdown-menu {
        max-width: calc(100vw - 1.5rem);
    }

    .form-control,
    .form-select,
    .input-group-text {
        min-height: 44px;
    }

    textarea.form-control {
        min-height: 7rem;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts {
        background:
            linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 7%, var(--surface-bg)), var(--surface-bg));
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 16px;
        box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.1);
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        padding: 1rem;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts-heading {
        align-items: center;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;

    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts-heading span {

        display: block;
        font-size: 0.68rem;

        letter-spacing: 0.06em;

    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts-heading h2 {

        font-weight: 800;

    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts-heading > i {
        align-items: center;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 10%, var(--surface-bg));
        border-radius: 10px;
        color: var(--primary-blue);
        display: inline-flex;
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        height: 40px;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 40px;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcuts-grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.6rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcut {
        align-items: center;
        background: var(--surface-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 12px;
        color: var(--text-dark);
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.65rem;
        min-height: 62px;
        padding: 0.65rem;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcut > i {
        align-items: center;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 9%, var(--surface-bg));
        border-radius: 9px;
        color: var(--primary-blue);
        display: inline-flex;
        flex: 0 0 38px;
        font-size: 1rem;
        height: 38px;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcut span {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 750;
        line-height: 1.2;
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }

    .dashboard-mobile-shortcut:active,
    .dashboard-mobile-shortcut:focus-visible {
        border-color: var(--primary-blue);
        box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(27, 57, 106, 0.15);
        color: var(--primary-blue);
        outline: 0;
        transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .users-desktop-actions {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle {
        align-items: center;
        background: var(--surface-bg);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 12px;
        box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgba(15, 35, 66, 0.08);
        color: var(--text-dark);
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
        min-height: 58px;
        padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
        text-align: left;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle > span {
        align-items: center;
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        min-width: 0;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle > span > i {
        align-items: center;
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-blue) 10%, var(--surface-bg));
        border-radius: 9px;
        color: var(--primary-blue);
        display: inline-flex;
        flex: 0 0 38px;
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        height: 38px;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle strong,
    .users-mobile-options-toggle small {
        display: block;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle strong {
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle small {
        color: var(--text-muted);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        margin-top: 0.1rem;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-chevron {
        color: var(--text-muted);
        transition: transform 180ms ease;
    }

    .users-mobile-options-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .users-mobile-options-chevron {
        transform: rotate(180deg);
    }

    .users-mobile-options {
        max-height: 0;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        opacity: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        transition: max-height 280ms ease, margin-bottom 220ms ease, opacity 160ms ease;
    }

    .users-mobile-options.show {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.85rem;
        max-height: 720px;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
        opacity: 1;
        overflow: visible;
    }

    .users-mobile-actions {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .users-mobile-actions .btn {
        align-items: center;
        display: inline-flex;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        gap: 0.4rem;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 46px;

    }

    .users-filter-section {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--soft-bg) 68%, transparent);
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        border-radius: 12px;
        margin-bottom: 0;
        padding: 0.7rem;
    }

    .users-filter-label {
        color: var(--text-muted);
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .users-filter-section .d-flex {
        display: grid !important;
        gap: 0.5rem !important;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    }

    .users-filter-section .btn {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        min-height: 42px;
        white-space: normal;
        width: 100%;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .main-content > .container-xl,
    .container-xl {
        padding-left: 0.75rem;
        padding-right: 0.75rem;
    }

    .card-body {
        padding: 0.85rem;
    }

    .card-body.p-0 {
        padding: 0 !important;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td {
        gap: 0.25rem;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        text-align: left;
    }

    .mobile-card-table .mobile-table-summary {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(6.5rem, auto) minmax(0, 1fr);
        text-align: right;
    }

    .mobile-card-table tbody td::before {
        margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
    }

    .main-content .d-flex.flex-wrap.gap-2 > .btn {
        flex: 1 1 calc(50% - 0.5rem);
    }

    .modal-footer {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

@media (hover: none) and (pointer: coarse) {
    .btn,
    .nav-link,
    .sidebar-item,
    .sidebar-group summary,
    .dropdown-item,
    .form-check-label {
        touch-action: manipulation;
    }

    .btn:hover,
    .card:hover {
        transform: none;
    }
}

/* Scroll independiente para el menú lateral */
.content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
    max-height: calc(100vh - var(--app-navbar-height, 70px));
    overflow-x: hidden;
    overflow-y: auto !important;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    padding-bottom: 78px;
    scrollbar-gutter: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
    height: 0;
    width: 0;
}

@supports (height: 100dvh) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        max-height: calc(100dvh - var(--app-navbar-height, 70px));
    }
}

@media (min-width: 769px) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        position: sticky;
        top: var(--app-navbar-height, 70px);
        align-self: flex-start;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        bottom: 0;
        max-height: calc(100vh - var(--app-navbar-height, 60px));
    }

    @supports (height: 100dvh) {
        .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
            max-height: calc(100dvh - var(--app-navbar-height, 60px));
        }
    }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar,
    .sidebar,
    .sidebar-mobile-backdrop {
        transition: none;
    }
}

@media (min-width: 769px) {
    .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
        bottom: auto;
        max-height: 100vh;
        min-height: 100vh;
        position: fixed !important;
        top: 0 !important;
    }

    @supports (height: 100dvh) {
        .content-wrapper .sidebar#appSidebar {
            max-height: 100dvh;
            min-height: 100dvh;
        }
    }
}
